paper_title: Correlated Stochastic Knapsack with a Submodular Objective
classifications: Theory of computation → Stochastic control and optimization
Theory of computation → Submodular optimization and polymatroids
statement: We consider the well studied correlated stochastic knapsack problem, generalizing its target function with submodularity to capture diminishing returns. An extra partition matroid constraint is added to generalize it and resolve an open question raised in a previous work to eliminate an assumption. We also make improvement on the approximation ratio. There is still a gap of 2 comparing to the variant with linear target function and we leave it as an open problem to close the gap.
